extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent examiners, applicants, attorneys, agents, and representatives of applicants
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the purpose, contents, and use of the USPTO Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) as a reference for patent examination and prosecution practice before the USPTO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Instructions to examiners
rubrics_metrics.description: The MPEP "contains instructions to examiners, as well as other material in the nature of information and interpretation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the MPEP as the authoritative reference for examiner instructions; it provides interpretive material and operational guidance examiners should consult when examining patent applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures required or authorized to follow
rubrics_metrics.description: The MPEP "outlines the current procedures which the examiners are required or authorized to follow in appropriate cases in the normal examination of a patent application."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When conducting examination, apply the MPEP's outlined procedures where applicable; distinguish between procedures that are mandatory (required) and those that are authorized discretionary practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference for applicants and practitioners
rubrics_metrics.description: The MPEP is published to provide "applicants, attorneys, agents, and representatives of applicants with a reference work on the practices and procedures relative to the prosecution of patent applications before the USPTO."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practitioners and applicants should consult the MPEP to understand USPTO practices and examiner expectations during prosecution and to prepare responses and filings consistent with Office practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of eMPEP search and navigation features
rubrics_metrics.description: The site provides links to "Search eMPEP" and notes help for search features (e.g., default operators, proximity searches, and wild cards) and navigation via eMPEP user manual and Quick Reference Guide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the eMPEP search functionality and consult the user manual/quick reference for effective searching (default operators, proximity, wildcards) and navigation of the MPEP content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult linked legal and policy resources
rubrics_metrics.description: The MPEP page links to Resource information and reference materials such as Patent Laws (latest published version), Patent Rules (latest published version), Patent Examination Policy Announcements, and MPEP Archives (1948 - present).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For statutory, regulatory, and historical context or updates, consult the linked Patent Laws, Patent Rules, policy announcements, and archives to ensure examination or prosecution actions align with current law and USPTO policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact and feedback procedures for MPEP
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information is provided: "Use MPEPFeedback@uspto.gov to send an inquiry to the MPEP staff. Additional questions may be sent to the Patent Examination Policy offices."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For questions, corrections, or feedback about the MPEP content or guidance, contact MPEP staff via the provided email or the Patent Examination Policy offices as appropriate.
